title_original: Tom Hopper, Rita Ora and Mila Harris to Star in Sci-Fi Thriller ‘The Signalers,’ WME Independent Launches Sales (EXCLUSIVE)

blocks.text: Tom Hopper (“The Umbrella Academy,” “The Terminal List”), singer and actress Rita Ora (“Fifty Shades of Grey,” “Tin Soldier”), and rising young Hollywood star Mila Harris (“No Exit,” “Mary”) are set to star in upcoming sci-fi adventure thriller “The Signalers.” Missi Pyle (“Galaxy Quest”) and Nolan North (“Uncharted”) have also joined the cast in supporting roles alongside Paulina Alvarez, David Silverman, and Wolfgang Fiegl.

Now in production, “The Signalers.” comes from Gramercy Park Media, was written by Cate Carson was (“The Plumber,” “Masque” and a former detective and military intelligence specialist) and is being directed by Gille Klabin (“The Wave”). WME Independent is handling domestic sales, while Peachtree Group provided the financing.

blocks.text: The film follows a remote air traffic controller (Hopper) and his estranged niece (Harris) after they detect an impossible signal deep in the Canadian wilderness that is causing strange and dangerous phenomena to occur. As they set off to uncover the origins of the troubling signal, they encounter research scientists (Ora and Pyle) also on the hunt for the occurrence, and inadvertently uncover a buried unearthly force that is awakening around them.

“We are thrilled to be on set capturing the intense, visually stunning excitement of this film,” said Harris of Peachtree Media Partners. “Cate’s script provides an incredible launching point for our cast to bring this story to life and with all the news about alien disclosures and otherworldly cover-ups, this classic Spielberg inspired film is exactly the type of story audiences have been waiting for!”

Joining Harris of Peachtree and Gramercy Park Media, the film features a producing team including Mary Aloe of Aloe Entertainment and Cate Carson and Jay De La Jara of Ed Motel Entertainment. Ford Corbett and Nathan Klingher of Gramercy Park Media are executive producing alongside Danielle Bisutti and Ron Greenbaum of Pen Ultimate Films and Samuel Mekonnen. The behind-the-scenes creative team includes director of photography Aaron Grasso, production designer Mollie Wartelle, and costume designer Erika Benton.
